meta.name: autonomous-loop
meta.description: Iterate until success or limit, composing existing skills with Jidoka integration

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动循环执行技能直到成功或达到上限
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要反复调用多个技能直到任务完成。
copy.tagline_en: Automatically loop skills until success or limit reached
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to repeatedly invoke skills until a task succeeds.

howto.what: Claude 会进入自动循环模式，反复执行任务（如代码修改、类型检查、代码检查），调用审查和调试技能，直到所有检查通过或达到最大尝试次数。期间不会自动提交或推送，遇到错误会尝试修复，严重问题则暂停等待人工干预。
howto.when: 当你要求 Claude ‘无需人工干预自动迭代’，或说出 ‘ralph mode’、‘继续迭代’ 等触发词时启用。

say.text: 启动 ralph 模式，自动执行当前任务直到成功。
say.note: 触发自动循环，最多迭代 5 次。

say.text: 继续迭代，直到所有检查通过。
say.note: 延续上次未完成的任务继续自动循环。

say.text: 自动修复代码并验证，失败时暂停。
say.note: Claude 会边修复边检查，达到上限后报告。

howto.what_en: Claude enters an autonomous loop that repeatedly executes a task (code changes, typecheck, lint), invokes review and debug skills until all checks pass or max iterations reached. It never auto-commits without verification and pauses on severe errors for human intervention.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask for hands-off iteration or use phrases like “ralph mode”, “keep going”, “iterate until done”.

say_en.text: Activate ralph mode and auto-iterate until success.
Keep going until all checks pass.
Auto-fix and verify, stop on failure.
say_en.note: Claude fixes and checks, reports if limit reached.
